sources.supports: Chat and embedding routes; prefixed request model; restricted routing; OpenAI embedding shape.
OpenRouter rates; USD Convex invoice; deployment/team limits are separate from application admission.
Upstream usage.cost represents total account charge in credits; does not itself prove Convex pass-through completeness.
OpenRouter credit system is denominated in USD.
Model-specific plain-chat framing; input envelope remains narrow and post-paid observed-token overruns deny delivery.

officialProvider.observedContract: SDK extracts raw usage.cost as dollar-cost metadata, but supplies no independent guarantee about all charge components.

inputControl.chat: Plain text system/user/assistant messages only; no tool/audio/image/provider-options/native response_format. Admission counts full UTF8 text bytes plus role bytes and 3-token per-message/terminal framing; malformed Unicode denies. Actual terminal usage over admitted bound withholds results.
inputControl.embedding: One string vector per billable call; UTF8-byte bound; pinned default1536 profile/index; no profile-switch fallback.
inputControl.semanticSchema: Only immutable facts-v1 or conflicts-v1 domain schemas, plain prompt JSON and strict backend parse; not native structured-output qualification.
